theorems.statement: (∀ (N n : ℕ) (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ Λ → ∃ δbar c₀ : ℝ, 0 < δbar ∧ 0 ≤ c₀ ∧ ∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δbar → 0 < ε → ε ≤ δ ^ 4 → ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n), ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3 ⊆ U → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → W.weight (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ → variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3) < ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2) → (∫⁻ z in ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) < ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2) → W.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) 2 ∧ y ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ¬ ((∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → variationMeasure W (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * W.weight (closedBall y ρ)) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * ρ ^ n)))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * ε) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (s : Finset (Euclidean N)) (Θ : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), x ∈ P.plane → ‖x‖ < 1 → (∀ y ∈ s, Grassmannian.project P y = x ∧ y ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) 2 ∧ y ∈ W.weight.support ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → variationMeasure W (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * W.weight (closedBall y ρ)) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * ρ ^ n)) ∧ ‖y - Grassmannian.project P y‖ < ε ∧ HasDensity n W.weight y (Θ y) ∧ 1 ≤ Θ y) → ∑ y ∈ s, Θ y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * W.weight (closedBall x 1) / unitBallVolume n + ENNReal.ofReal δ) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral V → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (k : ℝ≥0∞)) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight x θ ∧ 0 < θ) → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf V {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ ∀ Z ⊆ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, V.weight Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (G : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ L → (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) → (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → G ⊆ ⋃ i, Γ i → NullMeasurableSet G (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → ∫⁻ y in G, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + L ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * ∫⁻ a in (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), (∑' y : {y : Euclidean N // y ∈ G ∧ Grassmannian.project P y = a}, g y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n), ∃ Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → (∀ v : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ ≤ L / 4 * ‖v‖) → ∃ i, x ∈ Γ i) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 1 ≤ n → 0 < θ₀ → (∀ k, IsIntegral (W k)) → (∀ k, (W k).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ variationMeasure (W k) (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∃ δbar c₀ I₀ : ℝ, 0 < δbar ∧ 0 ≤ c₀ ∧ 0 < I₀ ∧ ∀ (δ : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δbar → (1 + δ) * (θ₀ + δ) + δ < k₀ + 1 → 4 * δ ^ 4 ≤ (unitBallVolume n).toReal → θ₀ * I₀ ≤ c₀ * δ ^ 4 + (1 + (4 * δ ^ 4 / (unitBallVolume n).toReal) ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * k₀ * I₀
